text: Offside (presented as 'OffSide – OffLimits') is the trade name of Rayat Al-Tahadi Investment Co., which equips and manufactures sports clothing; its executive director is Ammar Faisal Al-Khan.
short: Offside is the trade name of Rayat Al-Tahadi Investment Co, a sportswear company.

source.name: الكأس (al-kas.com) – النهضة يعلن شراكة استراتيجية مع شركة راية التحدي للاستثمار
source.quote: راية التحدي للاستثمار المعروفة أيضاً بالاسم التجاري “OffSide – OffLimits” المتخصصة في تجهيز وتصنيع الملابس الرياضية
source.note: Translation: 'Rayat Al-Tahadi Investment, also known by the trade name "OffSide – OffLimits", specialised in equipping and manufacturing sports clothing'. The article also names Ammar Faisal Al-Khan as Rayat's executive director.
